Name: Tropical_Dawn
DevComment: T-068b start values (spec §4): a soft peach between night and day; EV 0.5, fog #F6C7A0, sun 8 deg. Sun colour/intensity, moon, sky light and fog density/start are first guesses between Night and Day. T-068c (level-designer) tunes from previews. Anchor = the Dawn midpoint (06:00).

Name: Tropical_Day
DevComment: The approved day look moved as is from L_PalmKey.json time_of_day_presets.tropical_day (sun pitch 50, #FFF4E0, 10 lux; EV 1.0; fog #8FD3F0 0.05 from 30 m; sky x2.35/2.75/3.1; sky light 0.35) and the sea material (shallow #3ED1C4, deep #0A5560). WaveScale 0.7 = calm at noon. Anchor = the Day midpoint (12:00).

Name: Tropical_Dusk
DevComment: From the layout proposal tropical_dusk (EV 0, fog #FF9A5A 0.012 falloff 0.2 from 25 m); the layout had no sun, sky or sky-light values, so the day's sky values are kept and the sun (4 deg, #FFB27A, 3 lux) is a first guess for T-068c. Lamps on. Anchor = the Dusk midpoint (18:00).

Name: Tropical_Night
DevComment: From the layout proposal tropical_night (EV -3, fog #1B2440 0.02 falloff 0.15 from 15 m): night stays dark (fixed EV, no auto brightening), lamps and the Beacon carry it. Sun below the horizon and off; the moon (opposite the sun, 0.15 lux, #9DB4E0) is a first guess for T-068c. Anchor = the Night midpoint (00:00).
